california-palomar-mountain-and-east-gra.title: California · Palomar Mountain and East Grade
california-palomar-mountain-and-east-gra.slogan: A 204 km loop out of Escondido
california-palomar-mountain-and-east-gra.story: Short, sharp, technical: a proper southern California hill road. A 204 km loop that starts and ends near Escondido, about 3 h 55 of riding. It goes by way of Lake Henshaw view and Julian pie and. Palomar East Grade is the high point. It tops out at about 1,200 m. The passes are the reason to go.
